objective: estimate whether completing the independent criterion prompt before the first unaided product-style response changes that product response

assignment.controlInterpretation: product-before-criterion has no criterion retrieval before the primary product response
assignment.allocationConcealment: assignment generated after the eligible item frame and strata are frozen; participant and response raters do not receive the future assignment sequence

taskContract.response: one or more context-free meanings or translations
taskContract.reasonForFixedProbe: capture the primary product response for every randomized item without conditioning on post-assignment adaptive question selection

estimand.population: all randomized eligible participant-document lexical items under the approved developmental protocol
estimand.primary: intention-to-treat difference in product-response correctness: criterion-before-product minus product-before-criterion
estimand.equivalenceDecision: the approved confidence interval must lie wholly inside [-interferenceMargin, +interferenceMargin]
estimand.naturalAdaptiveAssessmentOutcome: exploratory only; fixed-probe estimand does not claim full adaptive-session transportability

decisionActions.equivalenceSupported: may submit criterion-before-product sequencing for confirmatory protocol approval; does not automatically authorize collection
decisionActions.materialInterference: confirmatory protocol must use split-sample, order, or carryover handling

unblockRule: freeze every applicable actualStudyDecisionFields value, consent/privacy operations, and the executable assignment/analysis package before any real developmental collection
